newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GROUP FIVE RISES ON NEW CEO APPOINTMENT.
newsitem.headline: GROUP FIVE RISES ON NEW CEO APPOINTMENT.

text.p: Shares in South African construction firm Group Five Ltd climbed on Thursday after the company appointed a new chief executive officer, dealers said.
By 1346 GMT Group Five shares were up 20 cents at 725 cents on a volume of 24,500 shares. They touched a day's high of 730 cents earlier.
"There's this notice that they have just appointed a new chief executive officer after the previous one resigned and that's probably why it's going better now," one dealer said.
Group Five said it had appointed Mike Lomas as the new CEO with immediate effect on Thursday following the resignation of Thuenis Kotzee on May 13, amid policy differences with the board.
"Mabye the market thinks Lomas is a good guy," a dealer added.
